title: ESF Signal Envelope
description: A typed external signal flowing through the External Signal Fabric. CloudEvents 1.0 core fields plus ESF extensions that make the signal auditable and safe to reason over: provenance (source), confidence, version, a freshness window, and the entity the signal is about. Formalizes the ESF provenance, schema, and freshness contract.

id.description: CloudEvents id: unique per signal occurrence.

source.description: CloudEvents source: the originating feed or system. The provenance root.

confidence.description: ESF extension: source confidence in the range 0 to 1, propagated into downstream reasoning so nothing consumes a low-confidence signal blindly.

signalversion.description: ESF extension: the checkpointed version of this signal, so a past decision is reproducible against the exact signal it used.

freshnessseconds.description: ESF extension: how long after time this signal stays valid. Past it the signal is stale and must not back a commitment.

entity.description: ESF extension: the entity this signal is about, used to reconcile conflicting signals for the same thing.
